title: A library version — visual-communication capability
description: Formal shape of a library version's `library.yaml` (DEC-001 point 5, DEC-003 points 1 and 4, DEC-004 points 1, 6 and 10): its name, its version, its kind, the oldest release of the capability whose tools it uses, and the libraries it builds on, each by its major. A brand may mark one of them as its base. A brand also names the DTCG version of its tokens, its Resolver document, and its open roles. Format 1 reads component libraries, brands and notations. Document-shaped schema. Companion per COR-018.

pkit_schema.description: The schema that binds this file (COR-023; DEC-002 point 3): `visual-communication:library`.

schema_version.description: The format number, shared by every schema of the capability (DEC-003 point 1).

needs-release.description: The oldest release of the capability whose tools and fields the library uses.

builds-on.description: The libraries it builds on, each by the major it fits. A brand marks at most one of them, a brand, as its base (DEC-004 point 6).

base.description: Marks the brand this brand builds on as its base: it resolves first, and this brand gives values only to the roles it opens.

dtcg.description: The DTCG version the brand's tokens follow.

resolver.description: The brand's Resolver document, within its version folder.

open.description: The brand's open roles: roles it exports, or groups of them by whole segments, that a brand built on it may give values (DEC-004 point 6). A brand with a base opens only roles its base opens to it.
